meta.name: DJPPR Communication Deck — Color Tokens
meta.source: Strategi Komunikasi DJPPR Semester II (29 Juni 2021)
meta.extractionMethod: Pixel-sampled from rendered slide PNGs (200dpi) using median/dominant-color clustering
meta.confidenceNote: core.* tokens are high-confidence (consistent across 3+ independent samples). accent.* and program.* tokens are lower-confidence (1-2 samples, may include JPEG/render artifacts) — verify against the source .pptx or Kemenkeu brand guideline before pixel-critical use.

purple.usage: Primary brand color. Section headings, small square bullet icons, badge pills, body accent text.

gold.usage: Primary accent color. Full-bleed section backgrounds, small square header icons, divider-slide side bars, stat highlight boxes.

magentaPink.usage: Secondary accent. Underline rules beneath headlines, gradient end-stop (see gradient.heroPurpleMagenta).

navy.usage: Icon fills on the circular roadmap/outline diagram; occasional dark accent.

lightBlue.usage: Thin arc / connector lines on the outline (agenda) slide.

neutralGray.usage: Secondary arc / connector lines on the outline slide; muted dividers.

plum.usage: Solid banner block (bottom-left of title/closing slides) — a flatter, less saturated purple than core.purple.

pageBackground.usage: Default light slide background, and the tint used behind the hero photo overlay.

textDark.usage: Default body copy on light backgrounds (approximation; body text also renders nearly black).

textOnDark.usage: Text/labels set on purple, magenta, or gold fills.

heroPurpleMagenta.direction: diagonal / radial, deep purple to magenta-pink
heroPurpleMagenta.usage: The deck's signature gradient. Used on: (1) full-bleed section-divider slides layered over a dimmed building/architecture photo, (2) solid card/panel fills for program call-out boxes (InFest, Talkshow, community program cards).

decorativeCluster.description: A 4-color folded-triangle motif in the bottom-right corner of title/closing slides, echoing the djppr logo's folded-corner mark.

programAccents.description: Colors specific to named sub-programs shown in the deck. Lower confidence — sampled once, only relevant if replicating that specific program's collateral rather than the general DJPPR system.

infestInkubasiTeal.usage: InFest Inkubasi DJPPR 'Financial Educator' sub-brand logo/key-visual accent (teal, paired with black).

mentorBadgeRose.usage: Dusty-rose name-tag pill under 'Calon Mentor' headshot grids.
